########################################################################
# Setup library

include(GrPlatform) #define LIB_SUFFIX

include_directories(../include)

########################################################################
# Optional UHD backend (Radar Step 11)
#
# ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND: AUTO (default) = build the UhdBurstBackend when UHD
# is found; ON = require UHD (configure error when missing); OFF = never.
# Without UHD the whole library (Phase A, EchoTimer, fake backend, all
# QA) builds and tests unchanged; the UHD-dependent TU is simply not
# compiled and uwb_uhd_burst_backend.h #errors if included directly.
########################################################################
set(ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND "AUTO" CACHE STRING
    "Build the UHD burst backend: AUTO (build when UHD found), ON (require UHD), OFF (never)")
set_property(CACHE ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND PROPERTY STRINGS AUTO ON OFF)
string(TOUPPER "${ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND}" ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND_UC)
if(NOT ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND_UC MATCHES "^(AUTO|ON|OFF)$")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND must be AUTO, ON or OFF "
        "(got '${ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND}')")
endif()

set(UWB_HAVE_UHD 0)
if(NOT ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND_UC STREQUAL "OFF")
    find_package(UHD CONFIG QUIET)
    if(NOT UHD_FOUND)
        find_package(PkgConfig QUIET)
        if(PkgConfig_FOUND)
            pkg_check_modules(UHD_PC QUIET uhd)
        endif()
    endif()
    if(UHD_FOUND OR UHD_PC_FOUND)
        set(UWB_HAVE_UHD 1)
    elseif(ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND_UC STREQUAL "ON")
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND=ON but UHD was not found "
            "(install libuhd-dev / UHD CMake or pkg-config support). "
            "Use ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND=AUTO to skip the backend instead.")
    else()
        message(STATUS
            "UHD not found: UhdBurstBackend disabled; the library, "
            "EchoTimer fake-backend QA and dry-run build without UHD.")
    endif()
endif()
message(STATUS "UHD burst backend (ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND=${ENABLE_UHD_BACKEND_UC}): "
    "${UWB_HAVE_UHD}")

list(APPEND uwb_sources
    uwb_energy_detector.cc
    uwb_preamble_detector.cc
    uwb_detector.cc
    uwb_detector_sc16.cc
    uwb_packet_writer.cc
    uwb_scheduled_extractor.cc
    uwb_scheduled_extractor_sc16.cc
    uwb_auto_scheduled_extractor_sc16.cc
    uwb_realtime_demodulator.cc
    uwb_rational_resampler_ccf_65_48.cc
    uwb_rational_resampler_ccf_65_32.cc
    uwb_pdu_rational_resampler_ccf_65_48.cc
    uwb_pdu_rational_resampler_ccf_65_32.cc
    uwb_pdu_window_crop.cc
    uwb_radar_packet_source.cc
    uwb_hrp_packet_source.cc
    uwb_loopback_echo.cc
    uwb_radar_cir_estimator_block.cc
    uwb_cir_writer.cc
    uwb_realtime_echo_timer.cc
    uwb_echo_timer_stream.cc
)
if(UWB_HAVE_UHD)
    list(APPEND uwb_sources uwb_uhd_burst_backend.cc)
endif()

set(uwb_sources "${uwb_sources}" PARENT_SCOPE)

# Also add headers if needed for compilation
if(NOT uwb_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT uwb_sources)

find_package(Threads REQUIRED)

add_library(gnuradio-uwb SHARED ${uwb_sources})
target_link_libraries(gnuradio-uwb
    gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime
    gnuradio::gnuradio-filter
    Volk::volk
    Threads::Threads
)
if(UWB_HAVE_UHD)
    if(NOT TARGET UHD::UHD)
        add_library(UHD::UHD INTERFACE IMPORTED GLOBAL)
        if(UHD_INCLUDE_DIRS)
            set_target_properties(UHD::UHD PROPERTIES
                INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${UHD_INCLUDE_DIRS}")
        endif()
        set_target_properties(UHD::UHD PROPERTIES
            INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "${UHD_LIBRARIES};${UHD_PC_LIBRARIES}")
    endif()
    target_link_libraries(gnuradio-uwb UHD::UHD)
    # Public so consumers including uwb_uhd_burst_backend.h see the guard.
    target_compile_definitions(gnuradio-uwb PUBLIC UWB_HAVE_UHD=1)
endif()
target_include_directories(gnuradio-uwb
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>
  )
set_target_properties(gnuradio-uwb PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_uwb_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-uwb PROPERTIES
        INSTALL_NAME_DIR "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib"
    )
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
GR_LIBRARY_FOO(gnuradio-uwb)

########################################################################
# M1-B: the standalone, GNU-Radio-free / UHD-free TWR protocol core.
#
# `uwb_twr_core.h` + `uwb_twr_protocol_time.h` are the PUBLIC installed M1-B
# contract.  The core is its OWN archive so an isolated install consumer can
# link it and PROVE (ldd/readelf) that it pulls in neither GNU Radio nor UHD
# (M1-B §8).  The fake link is transport/QA support and is NOT installed.
########################################################################
add_library(uwb_twr_core STATIC uwb_twr_core.cc)
target_include_directories(uwb_twr_core PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
set_target_properties(uwb_twr_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
install(TARGETS uwb_twr_core ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)

add_library(uwb_twr_fake_link STATIC uwb_twr_fake_link.cc)
target_include_directories(uwb_twr_fake_link PUBLIC
    $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>)
target_link_libraries(uwb_twr_fake_link PUBLIC uwb_twr_core)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

    qa_uwb_twr_tof_input.cc

# Anything we need to link to for the unit tests go here
list(APPEND GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-uwb gnuradio::gnuradio-blocks)

if(NOT test_uwb_sources)
    MESSAGE(STATUS "No C++ unit tests... skipping")
    return()
endif(NOT test_uwb_sources)

########################################################################
# M1-B pure protocol-core tests.
#
# These link ONLY uwb_twr_core / uwb_twr_fake_link / Boost.Test -- never
# gnuradio-uwb and never UHD -- so a green run is itself evidence that the
# protocol core is radio-free (M1-B §8).  They are registered separately from
# GR_ADD_CPP_TEST because that macro pulls in the whole GR link closure.
########################################################################
function(uwb_add_pure_twr_test test_name test_source)
    add_executable(${test_name} ${test_source})
    target_include_directories(${test_name}
        PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include)
    target_link_libraries(${test_name}
        PRIVATE uwb_twr_core uwb_twr_fake_link Boost::unit_test_framework)
    set_target_properties(${test_name} PROPERTIES
        COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "BOOST_TEST_DYN_LINK;BOOST_TEST_MAIN")
    add_test(NAME ${test_name} COMMAND ${test_name})
endfunction()

uwb_add_pure_twr_test(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_protocol_time.cc qa_uwb_twr_protocol_time.cc)
uwb_add_pure_twr_test(uwb_qa_uwb_twr_fake_link.cc qa_uwb_twr_fake_link.cc)

# ########################################################################
# Deterministic library resolution for EVERY test registered above.
#
# M0 review R8 / M0.1 §2.C.4.  GrTest's generated `<test>_test.sh` does
#     export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="":$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
# i.e. it APPENDS the caller's LD_LIBRARY_PATH, so the test's RUNPATH (which
# correctly points at the build tree) is only consulted when the caller has
# no LD_LIBRARY_PATH at all.  On this machine the default shell exports
# LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/usr/local/lib, so a plain `ctest` run linked the STALE
# installed libgnuradio-uwb rather than the one just built, while
# `env -u LD_LIBRARY_PATH ldd` showed the build tree.  A regression pass can
# therefore silently grade a CSV produced by the wrong library.
#
# The fix belongs in the registration, not in the operator's shell: pin
# LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the build tree for every test in this directory, so
# `ctest` and a hand-run of the same script resolve identically.
#
#   - the build lib dir goes FIRST, ahead of anything inherited;
#   - the inherited path is preserved AFTER it, so a developer who really
#     needs an extra path still gets it -- just not in a position that
#     shadows the library under test;
#   - nothing is removed, so this cannot break a working setup.
#
# Not a performance threshold change and not a behaviour change for the
# library: it only decides WHICH copy of the library a test loads.
# ########################################################################
set(UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH "${PROJECT_BINARY_DIR}/lib")
if(EXISTS "${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH}")
    get_property(_uwb_tests DIRECTORY PROPERTY TESTS)
    foreach(_t ${_uwb_tests})
        set_property(TEST ${_t} APPEND PROPERTY
            ENVIRONMENT "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH}:$ENV{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}")
    endforeach()
    message(STATUS "UWB CTest: pinning LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH} for "
                   "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR} tests")
endif()

# ########################################################################
# Serial execution for the throughput-sensitive tests.
#
# These measure PDU/s and input MS/s.  Running them concurrently with the rest
# of the suite on a 17-core box makes the numbers depend on how many other
# tests happen to be resident, so a failure cannot be attributed.  RUN_SERIAL
# makes each of them run alone.
#
# NOTE ON uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_rational_resampler.cc: its throughput assertions
# (>400 PDU/s, 200 Hz headroom >2, input >50 MS/s) have a standing historical
# failure tracked separately.  It is listed here for SERIAL EXECUTION ONLY --
# no threshold is changed, relaxed or re-baselined, and a new functional
# failure is never folded into it.
# ########################################################################
set(UWB_SERIAL_TESTS
    uwb_qa_uwb_rational_resampler.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_rational_resampler_65_32_stream.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_rational_resampler.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_rational_resampler_65_32.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_rational_resampler_65_32_workers.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_sc16_scale_65_32.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_sc16_scale_65_48.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_pdu_roi_cir_65_32.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_twr_phy_matrix.cc
    uwb_qa_uwb_twr_timing_budget.cc
)
foreach(_t ${UWB_SERIAL_TESTS})
    if(TEST ${_t})
        set_tests_properties(${_t} PROPERTIES RUN_SERIAL TRUE)
    endif()
endforeach()

# UHD-gated runtime QA: only compiled when UHD is available; verifies the
# device-unavailable contract without any USRP (skips when one exists).
if(UWB_HAVE_UHD)
    GR_ADD_CPP_TEST("uwb_qa_uwb_uhd_backend_device.cc"
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qa_uwb_uhd_backend_device.cc
    )
    # Device discovery can take several seconds on transport timeouts.
    set_tests_properties(uwb_qa_uwb_uhd_backend_device.cc PROPERTIES
        TIMEOUT 300)
    # Registered after the LD_LIBRARY_PATH block above, so pin it too.
    if(EXISTS "${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH}")
        set_property(TEST uwb_qa_uwb_uhd_backend_device.cc APPEND PROPERTY
            ENVIRONMENT "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=${UWB_CTEST_LIB_PATH}:$ENV{LD_LIBRARY_PATH}")
    endif()
endif()

# The two QAs that EMIT generated tables also need to know which build tree
# they were compiled into.  They write their CSV output under
# ${UWB_BUILD_DIR}/test-output by default and record the ABSOLUTE path of the
# libgnuradio-uwb the running process actually loaded, so a CSV generated
# against a stale /usr/local install is visible instead of silent
# (M0 review R7 / R8, M0.1 §2.C.2).

########################################################################
# UHD backend dry-run CLI (Radar Step 11)
#
# Pure-contract printer: includes NO UHD header and links neither UHD nor
# gnuradio-uwb, so it cannot open a device by construction.  Registered
# in CTest in both build configurations (UHD ON and OFF).
########################################################################
add_executable(uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run uwb_uhd_dry_run.cc)
target_compile_definitions(uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run PRIVATE UWB_NO_UHD_LINK=1)

add_test(NAME uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run
    COMMAND uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run
        --device-args addr=192.168.10.2
        --rate 737280000
        --tx-channel 0 --rx-channel 1
        --clock-source internal --time-source internal
        --pri-num 3686400 --pri-den 1
        --pre-guard-ticks 1475
        --tx-samples 140982 --rx-samples 55591
        --max-fragment-size 65536
        --t0-ticks 36864000
        --schedule-index 0)

add_test(NAME uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run_rejects_invalid_config
    COMMAND uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run --pri-num 0)
set_tests_properties(uwb_uhd_burst_dry_run_rejects_invalid_config
    PROPERTIES WILL_FAIL TRUE)
